name: Maximum Largest Order Shattered Set of Addressing
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. Maximum Largest Order Shattered Set is, by definition, the VC dimension. The addressing class has established VC dimension $\lfloor\log n\rfloor$.
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
